name: generic
description: Any project: Google Flow, vertical 9:16, off-screen narrator by default, clean photoreal look. Projects override only what differs.
closing: Clean frame, free of subtitles, captions, watermarks and logos.
visual_rules: Real camera behaviour only: handheld, locked-off, slow push-in or pull-back, slow pan. No drone swoops or whip pans.
Light comes from a source in the scene (window, tube light, streetlight, lamp, overcast sky).
One slow, simple, physical action per clip that could be filmed in a single take.
